title: Per-request location-assertor shim and KMS affinity tie-breaker (RBAC v2)
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Add per-request location assertion middleware for RBAC v2 and a KMS affinity tie-breaker; enrich audit logs with location proof headers; default behaviour preserves existing global fallback. No customer-facing API changes.
description:
Context and motivation: customers with strict data-residency requirements want stronger per-request enforcement when requests arrive through multi-region frontends and operator/back-office tooling. Current RBAC v2 decisions are made from tenant config + service-level defaults; this PR introduces a lightweight, opt-in per-request location-assertor shim that canonically translates request attributes into a location claim used by RBAC evaluation and a KMS affinity tie-breaker so KMS allocations prefer region-bound keys when available.

What this PR does (summary):
- Adds middleware (services/apigateway/middleware/location_assertor.go) that validates a request-scoped location proof header (X-Redwood-Location-Proof) or falls back to a cached tenant region. The middleware sets a normalized claim 'location:region:<zone>' that RBAC v2 can match against.
- Extends RBAC v2 matcher (policies/rbac/v2/matcher.go) to accept 'location' claims at decision time and to evaluate region-aware policies.
- Implements a KMS affinity tie-breaker (services/kms/allocator/affinity.go) so the allocator prefers CMKs bound to the asserted region; it preserves existing cross-region fallback behavior.
- Enriches audit payloads (pkg/audit/writer/enrich.go) with the asserted location and the evidence source (header | cached-tenant | operator-leased) to make retrospection deterministic. Audit header name: X-Redwood-Location-Proof-Source.
- Adds feature gate and config knobs: config/security.enableLocationAssertor, and kms.affinity.enabled with sensible defaults (off for legacy tenants).
- Tests: unit tests for matcher and allocator, integration test that exercises header-present and header-absent flows (tests/integration/location_assertor_test.go).

- validator: if header present -> verify signed proof TTL <= 5m -> set claim 'location:region:eu-west-1'

Compatibility and rollout plan:
- Feature is disabled by default for tenants with no residency constraints.
- For customers using region pinning, ops can enable the assertor via tenant-level flag; otherwise middleware only sets a cached-tenant region claim.
- KMS allocator affinity is a soft preference; when no region-bound CMK is available the allocator falls back to the existing global pool to avoid outages.

Review conversation highlights (condensed):
- Ethan Zhao: "Nice end-to-end. My concern is the synchronous call to the location proof verifier — that could add ~10-20ms per request under heavy load. Can we cache verification results keyed by proof id?"
  - Author (Maya): "Added an in-memory LRU cache with TTL and integrated it into the verifier; documented tunable TTL in helm values. See middleware cache layer and unit tests."
- Rashida Khan: "Need to be explicit in the docs about what constitutes 'proof' and how we fall back to tenant locality. Also request more audit fields (we added source but need evidence hash)."
  - Author: "Added evidenceHash to audit payload and expanded docs/security/location-assertion.md with threat model + examples."
- Oliver Martin: "Allocator changes look good but add a metric for 'kms_affinity_miss' so SRE can tune key placement."
  - Author: "Added kms.affinity.miss counter and a dashboard note in observability-pack."

CI and tests:
- Initial CI run: unit suite passed; one flaky integration test 'kvcache_integration_test' failed (unrelated).
- Reran CI after test isolation change; all checks passed. Final CI status: pass.

Security review:
- Security (SEC-221) reviewed threat model: accepted. We added signer rotation guidance for the proof verifier and limited proof TTL to minimize replay risk.

Operational considerations:
- Default telemetry added: rbac.location_assertions.total, rbac.location_assertions.from_header, kms.affinity.miss, cms.allocator.prefers_region.total.
- Documented recommended knobs for large fleets to disable per-request verification and instead rely on tenant caches.

Merge outcome: merged to main via squash on 2026-02-25 after approvals from Ethan and Rashida and green CI. Release notes prepared for the next patch release; no automatic breaking changes.

Notes for follow-ups:
- Add a migration guide for tenants that will flip the feature gate (include example helm overrides).
- Explore signed short-lived operator leases for edge cases where header proofs are not available.
- Consider a lightweight protobuf-based proof to reduce header size in streaming scenarios.

Design doc / further reading: docs/security/location-assertion.md (new) includes motivation, threat model, and sample RBAC v2 policy snippets for region-restricted service roles.
